name: GRT Electronics
old_description: GRT Electronics is a contract manufacturer offering full production services for our clients in a leaner and cost-effective approach. We are dedicated to on-time, schedule-driven performance with open communication to our clients.
about:
GRT Electronics operates from Raleigh, North Carolina, where it has provided contract electronics manufacturing services for more than four decades. The company is privately held, though its ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in full-turnkey electronics manufacturing, running automated SMT lines that place components as small as 0402 and as complex as 1,100-pin BGAs. Services span PCB assembly and rework, electromechanical box-build and rack integration, custom wire and cable harnesses, and a full test suite including burn-in, functional, X-ray, and environmental screening. Typical production runs range from 1 to 1,000 units, with occasional orders reaching 5,000 pieces.

GRT serves the automotive, industrial telecommunications, aerospace and defense, energy, and healthcare sectors. Named customers include Protochips, Robling Medical, Pfizer Zoetis, Analog Devices, ABB, Siemens, Honeywell, Agilent Technologies, Pentair, and Eaton. The company also supports IT server infrastructure and industrial control systems through rack-mounted assembly and high-performance computing integration.

GRT emphasizes a lean, cost-effective approach with on-time, schedule-driven performance and open communication. Its true-turnkey model covers component sourcing, PCB fabrication, assembly, and test under one roof. The quality system is ISO 9001:2015 certified and audited annually by an accredited third party, and the firm offers quick-turn prototypes plus design-for-manufacturing consultation.

name: Gavco Plastics Inc
old_description: From small parts to large parts, from even the simplest of parts to the extremely complex parts, when it comes to plastic injection molding, we do it all. Our clients range from independently owned businesses to Fortune 500 companies. Gavco Plastics has been the reliable source for Plastic Injection Molding needs for customers all over the USA.
about:
Gavco Plastics, Inc. operates from Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, about five miles east of Tulsa. The company was founded in 1976 by Randall Gavlik and remains a family‑owned corporation managed by a small, close‑knit staff of seven.

The shop runs 18 injection molding machines ranging from 85 to 880 tons, producing parts from one gram to twelve pounds around the clock. Beyond molding, Gavco provides tool and die manufacturing, insert molding, ultrasonic welding, pad printing, hot stamping, silk screening, clean‑room assembly, shrink‑wrap packaging, and design services such as mold‑flow and finite‑element analysis. The facility also handles prototyping via SLA and offers contract manufacturing and thermoforming.

Gavco serves aerospace, medical, automotive, food‑product, and environmental industries. Its customer base spans independently owned businesses to Fortune 500 companies, with the company noting that over 80 % of its growth in the past decade has come from existing clients.

The team’s combined 165 years of plastics experience and USA‑based, value‑added secondary operations are cited as key differentiators.

name: Genovac Antibody Discovery
old_description: Genovac specializes in antibody discovery and production against challenging targets. Our unique combination of genetic immunization, multiple host species, multiple single B cell platforms, and state-of-the-art production facilities enables us to serve as your one-stop-shop Gene to Antibody partner.
about:
Genovac Antibody Discovery operates from its headquarters in Fargo, North Dakota, with additional antibody discovery operations in Freiburg, Germany. The company traces its origins to 1999 when three University of Freiburg professors launched the venture based on the institution’s pioneering antibody research. In 2020, a management-led buyout of Aldevron’s antibody discovery business unit relaunched Genovac under its current structure.

The firm specializes in end-to-end antibody discovery and production against challenging targets such as ion channels and GPCRs. Its platform combines genetic immunization, multiple host species, and several single B cell screening technologies—including the Berkeley Lights Beacon instrument—alongside biologics production and a full suite of characterization services. Genovac reports more than 3,600 completed antibody discovery projects and 25 years of cumulative experience.

Genovac serves biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies developing therapeutic and diagnostic products. Its clients include organizations seeking antibodies against difficult multi-transmembrane proteins, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

The company positions itself as a one-stop-shop “Gene to Antibody” partner, emphasizing a unique combination of immunization technologies, species diversity, and screening platforms that aim to deliver hits where competitors fall short. The 2020 relaunch was driven by a goal to redefine the gold standard for difficult-target antibody delivery through continuous technology improvement.

name: George’s Furniture
old_description: Founded in 1970, George’s Woodcrafts, specializes in handcrafted, solid hardwood furniture for customers who appreciated quality construction. Since 1975, the business has operated at the present farm location just outside historic Maytown.
about:
George's Furniture is a second-generation family-owned business located in Marietta, Pennsylvania, operating from a farm location just outside historic Maytown since 1975. The company was founded in 1970 by George Martin as George's Woodcrafts, stemming from his early interest in woodworking and a rocking chair design he created at age 10. In 2008, George retired and passed the business to his daughter Juanita and son-in-law Chris Horst, who continue the tradition.

The workshop produces custom handcrafted Amish furniture using 100% solid hardwood—walnut, cherry, oak, and hard maple—with no plywood, particle board, or veneers. Each piece is built by a single craftsman from lumber selection through final finishing, signed and dated for authenticity. The process includes design consultation, customization of dimensions, finish, and details, and handcrafted construction. Typical lead time is 2-3 months. The company sells direct to customers, eliminating middleman markup.

The company serves residential customers seeking heirloom-quality furniture for homes, including tables, chairs, benches, and extension tables. They work with individual homeowners, interior designers, and clients in the Lancaster County region and beyond, shipping nationally. Examples include a customer from Brookeville, MD who purchased a table, chairs, and bench.

The business was started to address frustration with poor-quality furniture; George Martin's rocking chair innovation reflected a focus on durability and safety. The company differentiates itself through traditional Amish woodworking techniques, a year-long apprenticeship for craftsmen, direct-to-customer sales, and a lifetime value proposition.

name: Gillette Restaurant Equipment
old_description: at Gillette Restaurant Equipment is to provide the best NEW and USED kitchen equipment and supplies while offering superior customer service, quality consulting, innovative design and expedient deliveries!
about:
Gillette Restaurant Equipment was founded in 1989 by Ann Tyler in North Brookfield, Massachusetts. What began as a woman-owned venture to provide economical solutions for restaurant startups has grown into a regional supplier with two showrooms — in North Brookfield and Holyoke — supported by five warehouses across central Massachusetts.

The company stocks a full line of new and used commercial kitchen equipment, including cooking, bakery, refrigeration, ice machines, bar equipment, display cases, and stainless steel accessories. Inventory is sourced from major manufacturers and professionally inspected used units, allowing customers to choose between new and cost-effective pre-owned options. Beyond sales, Gillette provides consulting, layout planning, and equipment selection services to help operators design or upgrade commercial kitchens from concept through delivery.

Primary customers are independent restaurants, bars, catering operations, and other food-service businesses throughout New England. The team works with both new ventures and existing establishments looking to expand or replace equipment, offering project coordination that covers specification, procurement, and logistics.

Gillette emphasizes an economical approach to kitchen outfitting, combining product availability with design consulting and fast delivery. The company’s stated goal remains the same as at its founding: to supply quality equipment and expert guidance without exceeding the operator’s budget.

name: Global Foundries
old_description: We are a leading provider of sensor-enabled driver assistance systems. Our automotive platforms drive ADAS forward, contributing to safer autonomous driving systems with better vehicle control and ensuring passenger safety.
about:
GlobalFoundries is headquartered in Essex Junction, Vermont, and was founded in 2009 as a joint venture between Mubadala Investment Company and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) to address growing global demand for advanced semiconductors. The company's global headquarters and most advanced fabrication facility are located in Malta, New York, with additional manufacturing sites in Burlington, Vermont; Dresden, Germany; Singapore; and Guangzhou, China.

The company operates as a pure-play semiconductor foundry, providing end-to-end manufacturing services from chip design through wafer fabrication, assembly, and test. Its technology portfolio includes FD-SOI (FDX), FinFET, RF-SOI, SiGe, silicon photonics, advanced packaging (2.5D/3D), BCD, power GaN, and quantum-process platforms. The Malta fab is a highly automated 300 mm facility; the Burlington site specializes in RF and GaN; Dresden and Singapore provide high-volume production for long-lifecycle applications.

GlobalFoundries serves customers in aerospace and defense, automotive, data center and communications infrastructure, home and industrial IoT, and smart mobile devices. Publicly announced collaborations include partnerships with Marvell for optical connectivity, Renesas for U.S. manufacturing expansion, Silicon Labs for IoT production, SEALSQ for post-quantum cryptography, and Xanadu for quantum manufacturing.

The company emphasizes its differentiated technology portfolio, flexible global footprint spanning four continents, and deep co-innovation partnerships as key differentiators. It positions itself as a supplier of essential chips, offering manufacturing optionality and supply-chain resilience for security-critical and high-growth markets.

Golsh Plastics positions itself on quality and service as its specialty, backing that claim with a guarantee of quality products at great prices. The business was started to provide reliable, local access to packaging supplies for the Worcester community.

name: Good Source Foods, LLC
old_description: Ancient grains are what we used to eat before food became over-processed and pumped full of excess sugar. We use simple grains from Mother Nature that provide amazing nutrients and taste. Try our deliciously crunchy ancient grain snack bites today!
about:
Good Source Foods, LLC is headquartered in St Francis, Wisconsin, and was founded in 2019 with a mission to make healthy snacking convenient through ancient grains. The company began by focusing on slow-metabolizing nutrition that avoids the blood sugar spikes common in conventional snacks, building its product line around minimally processed, transparently labeled ingredients.

The company manufactures its own snack products — primarily ancient grain snack bites — in a state-of-the-art facility in the United States that adheres to high food safety and quality standards. While specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed, the operation is designed for clean-label formulation and consistent product integrity.

Good Source Foods serves the snack food, health food, natural food, and plant-based food sectors. Its products are positioned for retail distribution and direct-to-consumer channels, with a noted compliance to Whole Foods Market's banned ingredients list, indicating placement in premium natural grocery outlets.

The company differentiates itself by centering ancient grains that are higher in protein, fiber, and micronutrients, using plant-based, slow-metabolizing ingredients with no artificial additives or excess sugar. Its ethos emphasizes ethical sourcing, mindful portions, transparent labeling, and purposeful innovation that aligns taste with metabolic, cognitive, and digestive wellness.
